name: Lab components
description: React components vendored from lab.xevrion.dev into src/lab/components and browsable in the Lab screen.

items.name: Odometer
items.description: Rolls forward like a mechanical counter and wraps from 999 back to 000.

items.name: Hold to delete
items.description: Fills slowly while you commit to it, snaps back the moment you let go.

items.name: Segmented control
items.description: The pill stretches toward your pick like an inchworm, recoloring each label as its edge crosses.

items.name: Tilt card
items.description: Leans toward your cursor with a glare that follows the light.

items.name: Dock
items.description: Icons swell as your cursor nears them, and launch with a macOS-style bounce.

items.name: Sheet
items.description: Drag it down or flick it away; pull it up and it pushes back.

items.name: Toast stack
items.description: Stacks with depth, fans out on hover, and each toast's edge drains as its timer.

items.name: Elastic slider
items.description: Stretches like rubber when you drag past the end, then springs back.

items.name: Magnetic button
items.description: Stretches toward your cursor like soft rubber on a magnet, then wobbles home.

items.name: Text scramble
items.description: Hover a word and a block cursor reads it in, one letter at a time.

items.name: Swipe deck
items.description: Fling a card away and the rest of the deck steps forward.

items.name: Scroll reveal
items.description: Words light up one by one as you scroll through them.

items.name: Copy button
items.description: The two pages merge into one before a check draws itself in.

items.name: Expanding search
items.description: Opens from a circle into a search field, and closes faster than it opens.

items.name: Accordion
items.description: Answers unfold from under their question like a folded flap, and the row you clicked never moves.

items.name: Expanding card
items.description: Grows from its slot into a detail view and folds back when you are done.

items.name: OTP input
items.description: Six slots mirror one real input, so paste and SMS autofill just work.

items.name: Toggle switch
items.description: Leans into the move when pressed, then springs across and squashes on landing.

items.name: Command palette
items.description: Opens on ⌘K and filters commands as you type.

items.name: Marquee
items.description: Drifts endlessly past a reading lens, and brakes gently when you hover.

items.name: Reorder list
items.description: Picks rows up by the handle and slides the rest out of the way.

items.name: Compare slider
items.description: Drag the line to see what polish actually changes.

items.name: Multi-step form
items.description: Slides between steps while the card grows around each one.

items.name: Upload button
items.description: Shrinks into a progress ring, fills, then checks off.

items.name: Tooltip group
items.description: One tooltip slides from button to button and reshapes around each label.

items.name: Dropdown menu
items.description: Grows out of its trigger, and press, drag, release picks an item like a native menu.

items.name: Dynamic island
items.description: Morphs between live states with a springy, Apple-style bounce.

items.name: Scrub input
items.description: Drag the label and a tape measure runs under the needle, or just type.

items.name: Star rating
items.description: Hover to preview, click to commit with a little pop.

items.name: Like button
items.description: Pops, bursts and rolls the count when you like.

items.name: Sliding tabs
items.description: An underline stretches toward the tab you pick while a soft pill follows your pointer.

items.name: Page dots
items.description: A pill that inches between pages like a worm and counts down to the next.

items.name: Collapsible sidebar
items.description: Folds down to an icon rail, with labels that step aside before it closes.

items.name: Snap carousel
items.description: Snaps cards to center, drags with the mouse, and each card acts out its motion principle.

items.name: Skeleton loader
items.description: Holds the exact shape of what is coming, so nothing jumps.

items.name: Context menu
items.description: Opens at your cursor and grows from it.

items.name: Notification bell
items.description: Rings when something new arrives, and the badge rolls up with each one.

items.name: Avatar stack
items.description: Fans open when you reach for it, with a name above each face.

items.name: Morphing button
items.description: Shrinks into a spinner while it saves, then answers with a check or a shake.

items.name: Kanban board
items.description: Lift a card and the others slide aside to make room for it.

items.name: Color swatches
items.description: The ring glides to the color you pick and the color floods the preview from that side.

items.name: Mini calendar
items.description: Months slide past in the direction you travel.

items.name: Floating label
items.description: The label peels up letter by letter, and never covers what you wrote.

items.name: Password field
items.description: Reveals the password with a wave of dots turning into letters; the meter fills as it gets stronger.

items.name: Filter list
items.description: Rows fade out of the way while the rest slide up to close the gap.

items.name: Gauge
items.description: Ticks light up as the value sweeps in, and a peak marker holds where it was before falling.

items.name: Sparkline
items.description: Draws itself in, then scrubs to the nearest point under your cursor.

items.name: Bar chart
items.description: Grows its bars from the baseline and springs them between two weeks.

items.name: Stacked drawer
items.description: Stacks iOS sheets that push the page back and drag down to dismiss.

items.name: Confetti button
items.description: A click pops confetti; hold it and the fuse burns until the whole thing blows.

items.name: Typewriter
items.description: Types, pauses and rewrites the last word with a human rhythm.

items.name: Tag input
items.description: Your typed words stay put while a chip forms around them.

items.name: Range slider
items.description: Two thumbs that glide, stop at each other, and show their value as you drag.

items.name: Number stepper
items.description: Rolls each digit the way the count moves, and speeds up the longer you hold.

items.name: Select menu
items.description: Opens with your current choice sitting exactly on the button, macOS style.

items.name: Undo toast
items.description: Deletes instantly and gives you five seconds to change your mind.

items.name: File dropzone
items.description: Its dashed edge marches when a file enters the window and seals solid when it is overhead.

items.name: Chat thread
items.description: Replies arrive after a beat of typing, and the thread follows only if you are.

items.name: Loader set
items.description: Four loaders that each know how to finish: leapfrog dots, an inchworm bar, a ring that closes into a check.

items.name: Wheel picker
items.description: Spins through the hours on a curved drum, just like iOS.

items.name: Slide to confirm
items.description: Drag the knob all the way across to confirm.

items.name: Pull to refresh
items.description: Pull the feed down and new posts slide in at the top.

items.name: Hover card
items.description: One card travels between names as you hover them.

items.name: Tree view
items.description: Folders unfold in place while the selection glides to the file you pick.

items.name: Pricing toggle
items.description: Each digit rolls to its new price on its own, and new digits grow in.

items.name: Reading progress
items.description: A progress bar fills as you read while the time left counts down.

items.name: Code block
items.description: Switch files with a sliding underline and copy with one click.

items.name: Wave text
items.description: Letters rise in a wave that follows your cursor.

items.name: Dot grid
items.description: Dots swell and part around your cursor, and a click sends a shockwave.

items.name: Spotlight card
items.description: The cursor is a lamp: cards catch its glow and their icons cast shadows away from it.

items.name: Story progress
items.description: Tap through stories, hold to pause.

items.name: Data table
items.description: Sorts, selects and bulk-acts on rows without losing its place.

items.name: Combobox
items.description: The person you pick flies out of the list and into the field.

items.name: Date range picker
items.description: Paints the range as you hover, then commits it on the second click.

items.name: Inline edit
items.description: Edits your name and bio in place without moving a pixel.

items.name: Dialog
items.description: Opens a modal over the page, with a confirmation that stacks on top of it.

items.name: Pagination
items.description: Numbers roll in place like an odometer; the one you click never moves.

items.name: Announcement banner
items.description: Dismissing folds the bar away and the page slides up to fill the gap.

items.name: Shortcut sheet
items.description: Press ? anywhere to see every shortcut, then press one to watch it light up.

items.name: Spring playground
items.description: Tune a spring and watch its overshoot and settle, plotted live.

items.name: Easing editor
items.description: Drag a cubic-bezier into shape and see it move.

items.name: Stagger visualizer
items.description: Shows what per-item delay actually does to a list entrance.

items.name: Onboarding checklist
items.description: A setup checklist that counts up as you go and celebrates the finish.

items.name: Flip card
items.description: Turns over in 3D to show what is on the back.

items.name: Icon morph
items.description: Icons reshape themselves between states instead of swapping.

items.name: Sticky stack
items.description: Cards pile up and sink back as you scroll.

items.name: Infinite canvas
items.description: Pan, pinch and zoom around a board of notes.

items.name: Drag select
items.description: Draw a box across files to select them, like the desktop.

items.name: Sortable grid
items.description: Drag an app tile and the others slide out of its way.

items.name: Magnet lines
items.description: Lines turn toward your cursor like iron filings near a magnet.

items.name: Morphing nav
items.description: One dropdown panel reshapes and slides as you move between menu items.

items.name: Color picker
items.description: Drag a color out of the square, then fine-tune hue and opacity.

items.name: Card input
items.description: Formats as you type, spots the card brand, and flips to show the CVC.

items.name: Radio cards
items.description: The selection ring glides to the plan you pick.

items.name: Checkbox group
items.description: Check marks draw themselves in, and Shift-click fills a range.

items.name: Progress stepper
items.description: Fills the line toward the next step and unfills it in reverse.

items.name: Promise toast
items.description: One toast that morphs from saving to saved, or to an error with retry.

items.name: Confirm popover
items.description: Asks before deleting, from a popover that grows out of the button.

items.name: Activity timeline
items.description: New events slide in at the top as the line grows to meet them.

items.name: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Folds the middle of a deep path into a menu when space runs out.

items.name: Overflow tabs
items.description: Scrolls a long row of tabs, fading whichever edge still hides more.

items.name: Tab bar
items.description: A phone tab bar whose pill slides over and fills in the icon it lands on.

items.name: Selection toolbar
items.description: A formatting toolbar that grows out of whatever text you select.

items.name: Carousel 3d
items.description: Spin a ring of cards and flick it to land on the one you were aiming for.

items.name: Lens reveal
items.description: A lens follows your cursor and shows the specs hidden under a card.

items.name: Elastic string
items.description: Pull a string and let go to watch it ring back to rest.

items.name: Particle text
items.description: A word made of dots that part around your cursor and burst when clicked.

items.name: Theme toggle
items.description: A sun that folds its rays away and turns into a crescent moon.

items.name: Bookmark button
items.description: Fills from the bottom up and lands with a small squash.

items.name: Send button
items.description: The plane takes off along a curve, and a check lands in its place.

items.name: Download button
items.description: The arrow drops into the tray while the button fills with progress.

items.name: Contribution heatmap
items.description: A year of activity at a glance, sweeping in week by week.

items.name: Donut chart
items.description: Draws itself in, then lifts whichever slice you point at.

items.name: Stat counter
items.description: Numbers count up to their value; scrub a sparkline and the figure rolls back through its history.

items.name: Leaderboard
items.description: Players glide past each other to their new ranks.

items.name: Rotary dial
items.description: Drag a hole to the finger stop and each digit lands as the disc unwinds.

items.name: Tape measure
items.description: Pull the blade out to measure; release the lock and it reels itself back in.

items.name: Pull cord switch
items.description: Pull the ball chain to switch the site's lights; light pours from the bulb as a cone.

items.name: Combination lock
items.description: Spin right, left, right to fill each number, then turn the handle to open.

items.name: Rubber stamp
items.description: Stamps a document approved or rejected, with ink that looks pressed in.

items.name: Sticky note peel
items.description: Peel the top reminder off by its corner to mark it done.

items.name: Receipt printer
items.description: Feeds a receipt out of the slot line by line; twist it against the cutter to tear it off.

items.name: Tear off calendar
items.description: Tear a day off to move forward, pull one back to go back.

items.name: Balance scale
items.description: Weighs your pros against your cons on a balance that tips and slowly settles.

items.name: Tally counter
items.description: Counts in hand-drawn tally marks, one pen stroke at a time.

items.name: Ink well
items.description: Drains a glass inkwell as you spend your character limit.

items.name: Typing seismograph
items.description: Records the rhythm of your typing on a scrolling seismograph.

items.name: Envelope send
items.description: Folds your note into an envelope, seals it and sends it off.

items.name: Paper shredder
items.description: Drag a file into the shredder and it comes out in strips.

items.name: Tip jar
items.description: Coins drop into a glass jar and pile up as the total counts.

items.name: Zipper reveal
items.description: Unzip the pouch to reveal the code inside.

items.name: Cassette scrubber
items.description: Scrub audio by dragging the tape, with reels that spin like the real thing.

items.name: Bubble wrap
items.description: Pop every bubble to clear the list, one click or one long swipe.

items.name: Sundial picker
items.description: Pick a time by dragging the sun across the sky.

items.name: Folded map
items.description: An itinerary that unfolds panel by panel like a paper road map, recentring as it opens.

items.name: Scroll spine
items.description: Maps the article as a spine of bands, each as long as its section, filling in as you read.

items.name: Availability badge
items.description: Shows when the owner is working, and when that overlaps with your day.

items.name: Sidenotes
items.description: Slides footnotes into the margin beside their sentence, and folds them inline on narrow screens.

items.name: Footer signature
items.description: Signs the footer by hand when it scrolls into view, slowing through every loop.

items.name: Changelog stack
items.description: Files each release card behind the stack like a hand riffling index cards.

items.name: Pricing calculator
items.description: Itemizes your bill like an invoice and upgrades the plan the moment your team crosses a seat threshold.

items.name: Feature spotlight
items.description: A camera zooms into the part of the product screenshot each feature describes as you scroll past it.

items.name: Testimonial highlight
items.description: Swipes a highlighter across the line that sold the customer, one line at a time.

items.name: Waitlist join
items.description: Drops your face into a real queue and rolls out your place in line.

items.name: Cookie consent
items.description: Bakes a bite back into the cookie for every category you allow.

items.name: Email typo fix
items.description: Catches gmial.com and fixes it by moving only the letters that were wrong.

items.name: Coupon code
items.description: Stamps your promo code onto the order and strikes out the price it beat.

items.name: Code morph
items.description: Glides every surviving token to its new spot as a tutorial moves to the next step.

items.name: Image hotspots
items.description: Draws a leader line to one label card that travels between a watch's features, never covering the product.

items.name: Quote share
items.description: Lifts the words you select out of the paragraph and into a shareable quote card.

items.name: Waveform player
items.description: Inks in a podcast's waveform, with chapter markers and a ghost playhead.

items.name: Size picker
items.description: Pulls a tee over a body outline so you see the fit before you pick the size.

items.name: Order tracker
items.description: Drives a parcel across a street map to your door and stamps each stop as it arrives.

items.name: Gift wrap
items.description: Folds kraft paper over the cart item, ties a ribbon and bow, and asks who it's for.

items.name: Store hours
items.description: Draws the week's hours on a 24-hour scale and can redraw them in your own time zone.

items.name: Word rotator
items.description: Keeps the letters two words share and glides them into place as the rest trade out.

items.name: Keycap hint
items.description: Keycaps that sink when you press the real keys.

items.name: Caps lock warning
items.description: A small caps lock key with its light on slides into the field when caps is on.

items.name: Eye toggle
items.description: The eye shuts when your password is hidden and watches while you type.

items.name: Relative time
items.description: Says "4 min ago" and changes only at the moment the words would change.

items.name: Copy email
items.description: Click the address and its letters flip, one by one, into "Copied to clipboard".

items.name: Directional underline
items.description: The underline comes in from the side your cursor entered and leaves toward the side it left.

items.name: Hover preview link
items.description: Hover a link to get a preview card that trails your cursor and leans as it moves.

items.name: Scribble checkbox
items.description: Checks itself off with a quick pen stroke and strikes the words through.

items.name: Focus paragraph
items.description: Brings the sentence you're reading forward and lets the rest step back.

items.name: Text progress
items.description: Fills the label itself with ink as the upload runs.

items.name: Spoiler text
items.description: Hides a spoiler under shimmering grain that blows away from your click.

items.name: Badge counter
items.description: Rolls its digits the way the count moved and bumps each time it changes.

items.name: Star button
items.description: Spins once and throws off tiny sparks when starred, then rolls the count.

items.name: Follow button
items.description: Turns its plus into a check as you follow, and warns before you unfollow.

items.name: Live indicator
items.description: Breathes while live, lets the viewer count drift, and blinks hollow while reconnecting.

items.name: Mini clock
items.description: A tiny analog clock that sweeps in its city's time and turns dark after sundown.

items.name: Pixel loader
items.description: A tiny pixel grid that cycles spiral, snake, pulse and checker, then draws a check when done.

items.name: Greeting
items.description: Greets by time of day, with a sun or moon that rises into place along an arc.

items.name: Arrow callout
items.description: A handwritten note whose arrow draws itself to whatever it points at.

items.name: Voice orb
items.description: A glassy orb of drifting mist that listens to your real mic, thinks in a slow swirl and breathes as it speaks.

items.name: Call widget
items.description: Accept turns into hang-up as the call controls unfold out of it, one by one.

items.name: Logo orbit
items.description: Logos orbit a heading on tilted rings, passing behind it, and brake to a stop when you point.

items.name: Now playing
items.description: A listening-to pill whose record slides out from behind the cover and spins while it plays.

items.name: Uptime bar
items.description: Point at any day and the row's own caption tells you what happened.

items.name: Helpful prompt
items.description: Asks if the page helped, and on a no opens into a field right where the question was.

items.name: Back to top
items.description: Fills its ring as you read, and when you press it the arrow lifts off while the page glides back up.

items.name: Share button
items.description: Opens in place into copy, X and email, and the link turns into a check when it is copied.

items.name: Autosave status
items.description: A dot for unsaved changes splits into three while saving, then gathers into a check.

items.name: Reactions
items.description: Tap a reaction to add yours, or pick one and watch it fly into its pill as the count rolls.

items.name: Shortcut recorder
items.description: Press keys to set a shortcut: keycaps appear as you hold them, and it tells you when a combo is taken.

items.name: Storage meter
items.description: Point at any slice to read its size, then clear the cache and watch the total count down.

items.name: Status picker
items.description: Pick a status and the badge on your avatar turns into its shape: a dot, a moon, a stop sign or a ring.

items.name: Mood slider
items.description: The thumb is a face that frowns, grins and leans into the drag as you rate your day.

items.name: Signature pad
items.description: Ink that swells where you slow down, and wipes away the way you wrote it.
